notes: The accepted alignment put the supplied 'a' on πλείονα. Rule 58 places a determiner supplied for an anarthrous adjective-plus-noun phrase on the noun, and 18:24 in this same chapter already does so for 'an eloquent man'; rule 24's habit requires the two to be analysed alike.
ἐπί is unrepresented: the ASV realizes it nowhere in the English phrase.
